title: catha crenata
intro: Catha crenata, commonly known as Khat or Arabian tea, is a flowering plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. It has been used for centuries to provide a stimulating effect, and its health benefits include increased alertness, reduced fatigue, and improved appetite. The therapeutic actions of Catha crenata include its anxiolytic, antidepressant, and analgesic properties, making it a potential treatment for anxiety disorders, depression, and chronic pain. The bioactive constituents of Catha crenata include cathinone, cathine, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its psychoactive effects.
